name: Scene Stress
summary: Deliberately probes the scene contract's own ceilings instead of playing a game.
description: A discovery module, not a feature: each scenario intentionally sits on or past one documented ceiling of the scene contract (the 128-per-axis grid clamp, the 512-step path cap, the 8-image/88k-base64 image caps, and the server's 64k shared-output clamp) so the actual behaviour at each boundary is visible rather than assumed. Run /stress <scenario>, optionally /stress <scenario>:<arg>, or launch it as an app with no input to see the menu.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Run stress scenarios
permissions.description: Run scene-contract boundary probes in this space.

extension_points.name: Scene Stress
extension_points.description: Launch the scenario menu in the channel.
